arms.H: h_reset x reference_shape added to every house block after each non-initial election
arms.S: s_shock x multinomial_shape(s) added to Cov[s,s] after each non-initial election

T1.control_fits: stored v0.2 hyperparameters_exact; log-likelihoods recomputed by the harness
T1.extra_start: C0's fitted values for the segment with new parameters at their starts
T1.fit: MLE per segment on its fit date, production Nelder-Mead procedure

gates.T1-G1: W_e sum > C0 in >=2 of 3 decision windows and in total
gates.T1-G2: mean per-poll score >= C0 - 0.01 nats in each of M_2010, M_2014, M_2018, M_2022
gates.T1-G3: arm in-sample max log-likelihood >= C0 - 0.5 nats at every fit date; simplex; causality test

reported_only.2010: parameters not identified at the 2010 fit

rolling_weights.gate: better in >= 3 of 4 segments 2010-2022 and pooled
rolling_weights.metric: MSE vs effective-sample-weighted mean of polls published in (T, T+30], days with >= 3 polls

T1.score: one-step-ahead poll log predictive density (nats), prequential in fieldwork order

scoring.exclude: polls published on or before the segment's fit date
scoring.segment: last election with day <= fieldwork midpoint; fit at that result's availability

T1.selection: SH only if >= 2.0 nats over better single arm; else larger sum; exact tie S; none passing -> C0

T3.covariance_fit: fit_election_noise_b on the centred pool, unchanged
T3.final_refit: selected specification on all seven corrected residuals 2002-2026
T3.flag_2026: selected ES > 1.15 x control -> user decision before T4
T3.forecast: corrected consensus + r via apply_batch_simplex_transfer(eps=0.01 pp)

gates.T3-G2: each rolling target ES <= 1.10 x control

T3.seed: int(sha256('calibration-2030:T3:<year>:<rolling|loo|heldout>')[:8], 16); one default_rng draws Z (20000x9) then V (20000 chi2_5); extra seeds append ':1'..':4'
T3.selection: lowest rolling mean ES; prefer less complex arm within 1%; ties smaller beta then gaussian; none passing -> control

arms.F1: C0 with the noise pool built from corrected residuals (amendments 001 and 002); correctness, not gated

T4.flag_2026: CAND mean ES_vote on 2026 (decision horizons) > 1.15 x C0 -> user decision

gates.G1: pooled ES_vote <= 1.05 x C0 and <= 1.05 x F1
gates.G2: per election mean ES_vote <= 1.15 x C0
gates.G3: pooled ES_seat <= 1.05 x C0 and <= 1.05 x F1; Brier_coalition <= C0 + 0.01
gates.G6: complete, 349 seats, as_of-dated estimates, clean checkout, inputs per section 1
gates.G7: long set pooled ES_vote <= 1.05 x C0; plus calibration improvement if CAND changes dynamics

body_hash_scope: bytes strictly before the last '<!-- FREEZE-BLOCK-START -->' marker

T4_run: T2 preregistered and run, or skipped by user decision
